categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions CI workflow in `.github/workflows/code-signing-certificate.yml` to monitor Windows code-signing certificate expiration.
categories.rationale: Automating Windows code signing certificate expiration alerts helps prevent unexpected delays during release cycles, particularly short-notice bugfix releases. As the author notes, maintainers previously 'relied on Release Candidates as a dry-run for codesigners to realise that a certificate has expired'; adding an automated weekly CI check provides a helpful proactive monitor, but addresses a deferrable maintenance friction rather than an active breakage.
